audit_status.source_base: Greek 1 Corinthians text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for fleshly factionalism, planting/watering, God's field/building, foundation, temple, no boasting in humans.

verses.restored: And I, siblings, was not able to speak to you as spiritual ones, but as fleshly-patterned, as infants in Messiah.

familiar.text: And I, brethren, could not speak unto you as unto spiritual, but as unto carnal, even as unto babes in Christ.

verses.restored: I gave you milk to drink, not solid food, for you were not yet able. But not even now are you able,

familiar.text: I have fed you with milk, and not with meat: for hitherto ye were not able to bear it, neither yet now are ye able.

verses.restored: for you are still fleshly-patterned. For where there is jealousy and strife among you, are you not fleshly-patterned and walking according to human ways?

familiar.text: For ye are yet carnal: for whereas there is among you envying, and strife, and divisions, are ye not carnal, and walk as men?

verses.restored: For when one says, I am of Paul, and another, I of Apollos, are you not merely human?

familiar.text: For while one saith, I am of Paul; and another, I am of Apollos; are ye not carnal?

verses.restored: What then is Apollos? And what is Paul? Servants through whom you trusted, as the Lord gave to each.

familiar.text: Who then is Paul, and who is Apollos, but ministers by whom ye believed, even as the Lord gave to every man?

verses.restored: I planted, Apollos watered, but the Divine caused growth.

familiar.text: I have planted, Apollos watered; but God gave the increase.

verses.restored: So then neither the one planting is anything nor the one watering, but the Divine causing growth.

familiar.text: So then neither is he that planteth any thing, neither he that watereth; but God that giveth the increase.

verses.restored: The one planting and the one watering are one, and each will receive one's own wage according to one's own labor.

familiar.text: Now he that planteth and he that watereth are one: and every man shall receive his own reward according to his own labour.

verses.restored: For we are coworkers of the Divine; you are field of the Divine, building of the Divine.

familiar.text: For we are labourers together with God: ye are God’s husbandry, ye are God’s building.

verses.restored: According to the grace of the Divine given to me, like a wise master-builder I laid a foundation, and another builds upon it. But let each watch how one builds upon it.

familiar.text: According to the grace of God which is given unto me, as a wise masterbuilder, I have laid the foundation, and another buildeth thereon. But let every man take heed how he buildeth thereupon.

verses.restored: For no one is able to lay another foundation beside the one being laid, which is Jesus Messiah.

familiar.text: For other foundation can no man lay than that is laid, which is Jesus Christ.

verses.restored: If anyone builds upon the foundation gold, silver, precious stones, wood, hay, straw,

familiar.text: Now if any man build upon this foundation gold, silver, precious stones, wood, hay, stubble;

verses.restored: each one's work will become manifest; for the day will make it clear, because it is unveiled in fire, and the fire itself will test what sort each one's work is.

familiar.text: Every man’s work shall be made manifest: for the day shall declare it, because it shall be revealed by fire; and the fire shall try every man’s work of what sort it is.

verses.restored: If anyone's work that was built remains, that one will receive a wage.

familiar.text: If any man’s work abide which he hath built thereupon, he shall receive a reward.

verses.restored: If anyone's work is burned up, that one will suffer loss, but that one will be saved/healed, yet so as through fire.

familiar.text: If any man’s work shall be burned, he shall suffer loss: but he himself shall be saved; yet so as by fire.

verses.restored: Do you not know that you are temple of the Divine and the Spirit of the Divine dwells in you?

familiar.text: Know ye not that ye are the temple of God, and that the Spirit of God dwelleth in you?

verses.restored: If anyone destroys the temple of the Divine, the Divine will destroy that one; for the temple of the Divine is holy, which you are.

familiar.text: If any man defile the temple of God, him shall God destroy; for the temple of God is holy, which temple ye are.

verses.restored: Let no one deceive oneself. If anyone among you thinks oneself wise in this age, let that one become foolish, so that one may become wise.

familiar.text: Let no man deceive himself. If any man among you seemeth to be wise in this world, let him become a fool, that he may be wise.

verses.restored: For the wisdom of this world is foolishness before the Divine; for it is written: He catches the wise in their craftiness.

familiar.text: For the wisdom of this world is foolishness with God. For it is written, He taketh the wise in their own craftiness.

verses.restored: And again: The Lord knows the reasonings of the wise, that they are empty.

familiar.text: And again, The Lord knoweth the thoughts of the wise, that they are vain.

verses.restored: So then let no one boast in humans. For all things are yours:

familiar.text: Therefore let no man glory in men. For all things are yours;

verses.restored: whether Paul or Apollos or Cephas, or world or life or death, or present things or coming things—all are yours,

familiar.text: Whether Paul, or Apollos, or Cephas, or the world, or life, or death, or things present, or things to come; all are yours;

verses.restored: and you are Messiah's, and Messiah is the Divine's.

familiar.text: And ye are Christ’s; and Christ is God’s.

translation_notes: You are temple in verses 16-17 is plural/community-focused; the assembly is the holy dwelling, so division becomes temple-harm.
Fleshly-patterned refers to factional ego-behavior, not the material body as evil.
